tonight.headline: Swaps made — the D/ST seat is the last hole
body: Bad news first. The Rams D/ST are on bye and still in your lineup at 0.0, with no rule-clean drop to fill the seat; Jacobs is out and on bye; Marks is unlikely for Thursday with a concussion. You made both receiver swaps at 10:31 CDMX, so the lineup is otherwise the projection lineup.

ESPN projects 117.4 to 84.2 and gives you 68% — but KEI returns start two byes (Drake London, Zach Charbonnet) with Jonah Coleman (19.5) and Adonai Mitchell (10.6) on their bench. Filled, they are near 114. A D/ST is worth more this week than the 68% suggests.

case.label: The script that beats you
case.body: KEI put Coleman and Mitchell in for London and Charbonnet: 84.2 + 30.1 = 114.3 against your 117.4 with a zero at D/ST (league file).

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A free-agent D/ST after 02:00 Wednesday adds 7-9 projected points — but only by dropping Marks; see the fallback card.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Fallback only — free agents from Wed 02:00, Marks locks Thu 19:15
doFirst.title: Fill the D/ST seat — only if you accept dropping Marks
doFirst.subtitle: No claim — priority never resets. A free agent after 02:00 Wednesday, and a drop the brief will not fire for you.

case.label: The hole
case.body: The Rams are on bye and you carry no second defence: the D/ST slot scores 0.0. Every unrostered D/ST is on waivers until Wed 18 Nov 02:00 CDMX (league file, 22:05Z).

case.label: Why it matters more tonight
case.body: KEI returns can fill their two bye seats from their own bench and project near 114 against your 117.4 (league file). A 7-9 point D/ST is most of that margin.

case.label: Why it is still a fallback
case.body: Adding means dropping someone, and Woody Marks is the only bench player whose week is already zero (Ryans does not expect him to clear for Thursday; NBC 17 Nov). But your add-thesis on him has not tripped: its live clause needs a game Marks and Montgomery both play. The runbook does not drop a player whose thesis stands, so this card is not armed.

case.label: If you choose it
case.body: After 02:00 Wednesday add the highest-projected free-agent D/ST left — Steelers (9.2, vs Joe Milton's Eagles) if no one claimed them, else Jets (7.8), else Chargers (6.8) — and drop Marks before Houston kick off Thursday 19:15 CDMX, when he locks.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Houston rule Marks out with Montgomery active on Wednesday's or Thursday's report — the reason Marks was added (Montgomery's absence) is then gone, and the drop becomes a real recommendation.

doFirst.sources: ESPN league file · NBC · Yahoo · STRATEGY §4

whatWentWrong.title: Marks is out and Montgomery is back
whatWentWrong.lead: Ryans doubts Marks clears protocol for Thursday; Montgomery is tentatively expected to return.

case.label: What happened
case.body: Marks took a concussion in Week 10 and did not practise Monday; Ryans does not expect him to clear for Thursday (NBC 17 Nov). Montgomery, out four games, practised in full and is 'tentatively expected to return' (NBC 17 Nov).

case.label: What it changes
case.body: Marks is the natural seat for a one-week D/ST — but his thesis has not tripped, so the D/ST card stays a fallback.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Houston's Wednesday report ruling Marks out with Montgomery a full participant.

worthALook.name: Omarion Hampton
worthALook.lead: 22 carries and an 81.5% carry share — on waivers here, and priority never resets.

case.label: The player
case.body: His first 100-yard game of the season on Monday night with a touchdown (CBS 17 Nov): 22 carries, an 81.5% carry share, but 2 targets — DraftSharks credits game script (17 Nov, carried).

case.label: The matchup
case.body: CBS says start him against a Jets defence allowing 4.5 yards a carry with the Chargers favoured (17 Nov).

case.label: Why not now
case.body: At 12.6 projected he would not start over Tuten (17.0), Taylor (16.4) or Gordon (13.9), and a claim drops you to last for the season. A bench back is not the one.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Jacobs' return slipping past Week 13, or a Taylor or Tuten injury — then he would start immediately, which is the only case STRATEGY §4 spends priority on.

worthALook.name: Chargers D/ST

case.label: The case
case.body: FF Hound recommends streaming them against the Jets — especially if Cade Klubnik starts — and keeping them for Week 12 against New England with Drake Maye out (Forbes/Yahoo 16 Nov).

case.label: Against it
case.body: Geno Smith is now expected to start for the Jets if cleared (Rapoport via Athlon 17 Nov), and NBC notes the Chargers averaged 3.2 points a game over six weeks (17 Nov). Projected 6.8, behind the Steelers (9.2) and Jets (7.8).

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Smith ruled out — then the Chargers move ahead of the Jets D/ST in the fallback order.
